listing.summary: Two Ready at Dawn titles brought through combat; movies skipped; browser saves not directly interoperable with PSP encrypted saves. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Owned PSP ISO or extracted disc; decrypted EBOOT via external PSP_DECRYPT; exact regional IDs not stated in README.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local Linux setup.sh/port.sh/serve.sh compiles generated C++ to WASM from owned input and externally decrypted EBOOT; served browser player uses original disc data over HTTP Range. Native flag creates headless diagnostic runner.
